article_title: The Effect of Error Correction Feedback on the Collocation Competence of Iranian EFL Learners
citation: Jafarpour, A. A., & Sharifi, A. (2012). The effect of error correction feedback on the collocation competence of Iranian EFL learners. Teaching English with Technology, 12(3), 3-17. http://www.tewtjournal.org
title: 90-item multiple-choice collocation test based on Benson et al. (1986) categories
description: A multiple-choice test of common collocation errors used as both pretest and post-test in the study. "A multiple-choice collocation test was prepared based on Benson et al.'s (1986) categories in this study, 15 items of collocations for each category." The test was "studied and evaluated by English experts to ensure test reliability and validity." Items were drawn from the Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English, The BBI Dictionary of English Word Combination, and The British National Corpus, using common errors from Fitikides' Common Mistakes Book and Chia Chuan's study.
requirements: Items must be evaluated by English experts for reliability and validity
examples: The test was administered as a pretest and again one month later as a post-test to prevent test-to-test effect
